title: Response errors become KaavaRpcError instances
description: Verifies that error responses from the shell are converted to KaavaRpcError with code and message.
given: A client that has sent an invoke
when: A response with an error envelope arrives
then: The promise rejects with a KaavaRpcError instance carrying the code and message
impl_ref: packages/bridge/src/client.test.ts::rejects with a KaavaRpcError carrying the shell's error envelope
